text:
Jordan (Sales): heads-up — Aurora Capital sent the SIG yesterday, deadline EOD Friday. they want question-by-question evidence. can we own this?
Maya (SolutionsEng): I can take Q1–Q40 (architecture + network controls). Vince can you take infra/security Q41–Q90?
Vince (InfoSec): I’ll do Q41–Q90. need the latest SOC2 and pentest artifacts — do we have an approved package?
Rebecca (Compliance): SOC2 Type II report (2024-10) + penetration test summary (2025-01) are in the secure bucket. link: https://r-secure.internal/sig-packages/aurora-2025 (redacted access)
Jordan (Sales): FYI Sam from Aurora is on thread — @Sam can you confirm they prefer evidence as ZIP upload to the SIG portal or inline links?
Sam (Aurora Capital): ZIP preferred for our risk team. also need explicit answers for KMS, BYOK, and data residency.
Maya (SolutionsEng): Copy. I'll prepare the architecture diagram and a short narrative for encryption at rest/in transit.
Maya (SolutionsEng): attaching file list I plan to include:
```
- redwood-arch-v2.pdf
- network-segmentation.png
- kms-overview.md
- service-boundaries.txt
```
Vince (InfoSec): I'll pull the encryption keys policy and KMS rotation proof. quick Q — are we listing HSM usage? We use customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; hosted uses cloud KMS with rotation SLA.
Rebecca (Compliance): Answer the SIG question with both variants: "Hosted — cloud KMS (managed), Dedicated/Private — customer KMS/HSM optional". Add evidence: key rotation logs for hosted, and HSM cert for private.
Vince (InfoSec): noted. I'll add file names and samples: `kms-rotation-202502.log`, `hsm-csr-2024.pem`, `key-access-roles.csv`
Jordan (Sales): Sam — we'll include a short note on data residency and contract controls. they asked about EU data residency specifically.
Sam (Aurora Capital): Yes EU residency required for production data. can you confirm region options and contract addendum?
Maya (SolutionsEng): Regions: eu-west-1 & eu-central-1 available on Dedicated and Private. Hosted API currently stores embeddings in region per customer setting; addendum template: `data-residency-amendment-2024.docx`
Vince (InfoSec): Security Qs we still need: vulnerability cadence (we do monthly scans + triage), RTO/RPO for backups (RTO 4h, RPO 1h for critical metadata), and pen-test remediation timeline (30 days for high).
Rebecca (Compliance): I'll draft polished answers for those and check wording against the SIG question IDs so nothing mismatches.
Maya (SolutionsEng): Can someone confirm SSO + identity provisioning? We support SAML SSO and SCIM for user provisioning; MFA enforced via SSO. Evidence: `sso-saml-metadata.xml`, `scim-provisioning-sample.json`.
Vince (InfoSec): Added. Also include TLS config: minimum TLS 1.2, prefer 1.3, cert rotation cadence 90 days.
Jordan (Sales): Good. plan: Maya bundles Q1–Q40, Vince Q41–Q90, Rebecca will review legal wording, then Jordan will upload ZIP to SIG portal and notify Aurora. ETA: tomorrow lunchtime for draft?
Maya (SolutionsEng): I can have the draft bundle by 11:30.
Vince (InfoSec): I’ll finish my section by 12:15 and drop samples to the same folder.
Rebecca (Compliance): I’ll review by 13:30 and flag anything that needs redaction.
Jordan (Sales): evidence-bot — please create an evidence package folder and grant Aurora read-only access after upload.
evidence-bot: Created folder `sigs/aurora_capital/1780012345/` and set ACLs. Link: https://r-secure.internal/sigs/aurora_capital/1780012345 (redacted) :white_check_mark:
Sam (Aurora Capital): Thanks everyone. please note Aurora's procurement also wants a pen-test scope summary — include the external testing vendor and date.
Vince (InfoSec): vendor is RedFence Security, external pentest completed 2025-01-14, summary `redfence-summary-20250114.pdf`.
Jordan (Sales): perfect. Final ask — Rebecca, can you sign off for public-facing language so legal is happy attaching to the portal?
Rebecca (Compliance): yes will sign off if there are no export-controlled details. I’ll ping if any edits needed. :+1:
Jordan (Sales): sweet. I’ll coordinate the upload and let Aurora know once the ZIP is in the portal. thanks team :rocket:
